reason: A Windows and macOS desktop launcher that starts DeepSeek Harness locally, opens it in an isolated Chrome or Edge application window, persists local sessions, and stops the service when the window closes.

summaries.zh: 用于在 Windows 和 macOS 上双击启动 DeepSeek Harness、本地运行服务并通过独立的 Chrome 或 Edge 应用窗口访问。
summaries.en: A Windows and macOS desktop launcher that starts DeepSeek Harness locally and opens it in an isolated Chrome or Edge application window.

capabilities: Downloads DeepSeek Harness dependencies through npx
Starts and stops a local background service
Opens a Chrome or Edge application window
Uses local session data and configurable local ports
